newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Turkish youth in Belgian classroom killing.
newsitem.headline: Turkish youth in Belgian classroom killing.

text.p: A 15-year-old youth burst into his own school classroom in Brussels and shot dead a 14-year-old classmate after the two had a row in the playground, Belgian newspapers reported on Tuesday.

They said the youth pumped seven nine-millimetre rounds from an automatic pistol into the chest and stomach of his victim on Monday after the two -- both of Turkish origin -- had fallen out in the school playground.
He told police he had bought the gun on the black market from a Yugoslav dealer.
Belgium has long been known as a major crossroads in the illegal arms trade in Europe, and the story ran in some newspapers alongside a report of a large seizure of guns and ammunition in Liege.

Police seized more than 30 handguns and 8,000 rounds of ammunition in the raid on a building on the outskirts of Liege -- known locally as the Palermo of Belgium because of its large Italian population and connections with organised crime.
